description: This file is a script for managing changelog entries, including normalizing PR changelog entries, validating changelog entries for a specific PR, and ensuring merge hygiene. It combines Bash scripting with embedded Node.js code to manipulate the CHANGELOG.md file based on PR information.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Reads PR number, updates CHANGELOG.md to normalize the changelog entries for that PR, organizing them into proper sections.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the changelog entry for a specific PR is properly placed and references are correct.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures no PR references are improperly dropped or duplicated during merge conflicts in CHANGELOG.md.
